evidence_ids: Actual workflow-condition tests reject forks, Dependabot actors and Dependabot-authored PRs, including maintainer-triggered events.
Workflow tests admit trusted PRs and main pushes, reject predicate-removal mutations, and assert static/mutation jobs remain ungated.
Original Dependabot patch comparison, contract generated-drift check, complete validation and npm audit.

security_justification.trust_boundary: Fork and Dependabot PRs visibly skip private Sonar analysis. No untrusted checkout gains access to restricted secrets.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Actor, PR author and head repository are GitHub event metadata. Both bot actor and bot author disqualify a PR; no author assertion establishes trust.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No tokens are created, copied or exposed. Trusted Sonar authentication and quality gates are unchanged.
security_justification.audit_integrity: GitHub records a skipped job distinctly from a successful analysis. Frozen contract events and generated artifacts are unchanged.
security_justification.confidentiality: The job guard prevents secret-bearing analysis of untrusted PRs. Tests use synthetic public event identities and no credentials.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only the enumerated workflow, regression test, planning artifacts and contract development lockfile are owned. Canonical source and generated contract files are excluded.
security_justification.fail_posture: Only policy-authorized untrusted analysis skips. Missing trusted credentials, scan failures and quality-gate failures still fail; merge logic is unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The guard and tests handle public repository and login metadata. No new credential or payload diagnostic is emitted.
security_justification.concurrency: No worker, shared mutable state or CI concurrency setting changes. Existing job dependencies and scan ordering remain.
security_justification.lifecycle: The assessment precedes the replayed implementation in submitted history. Historical bot execution is not retroactively approved. Archive remains a separate lifecycle step.
security_justification.resource_retention: Untrusted runs allocate no Sonar job resources. Trusted caches, artifacts and retention are unchanged.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Trusted scan retry and coverage-download retry semantics remain intact. Untrusted analysis is skipped before either executes.
security_justification.cryptography: The lockfile integrity is the upstream patched artifact hash. No signing, verification algorithm or secret-storage policy changes.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal payload, telemetry, event transformation or privacy policy changes. Fixtures use synthetic event metadata.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Existing Sonar analysis is gated by its existing trust policy; no new analysis service, collector or integration is introduced.
